g.text: Harness schemas — attributes derived from JSON Schema
lifecycleStages [0..*] : list<plan | author | validate | review | test | publish | feedback | retire>
sources [1..*] : {title, instance, libraryId, path, url, year}[]
rules [1..*] : {id, title, description, category, severity, source, patterns, terminology, judgementOnly}[]
appliesTo [0..*] : list<enum(17) | docs | skill | readme | specification | code>
authority [1] : OMG | DCMI | W3C | IETF | ISO | HL7 | other
adversarial_reviews [0..*] : {reviewer, author_sessions, skill_hash, at, coverage, result, flags, findings}[]
As a <role> I want <want> so that <soThat>.
SMART DAK's SGUserStory is the external shape.
XSD, not JSON Schema: the elements
listed are the operative terms pinned
checked against the skill's input and output
